title: Intel Stock (INTC) Rises 5.5% as Chip Stocks Rebound (Nov 9)
summary: Intel (INTC) rose 5.49% to $59.37 on Nov 9, 2026 as chip stocks rebounded, with the semiconductor index posting its best day since July.
body_markdown:
## Why Intel Stock Rose


Financial media tied the gain to a sector-wide recovery rather than to news from Intel itself. According to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/intel-took-25-years-to-get-back-to-its-dot-com-peak--and-lost-it-in-6-months-chart-of-the-day-144715722.html) , chip stocks bounced on Friday and Monday after a five-week rout that followed an[AI-driven selloff](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nasdaq-record-point-loss-ai-stock-rout-wipes-25-trillion-us-futures-mixed-before-payrolls/) , and the S&P 500 posted its biggest gain since April. The same report noted that Intel remained up roughly 60% for the year after slipping back below its dot-com era peak on October 30, 2026.


Pressure on Nvidia also shaped the session. As reported by[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-falls-5-board-probes-134356169.html) , money rotated away from Nvidia after its board said it would[investigate CEO Jensen Huang's relationship](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-spy-affair-probe-rattles-markets/) with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, an allegation China's Foreign Ministry called unsubstantiated. The outlet said Intel traded little changed before the open, a sign in its view that the selling had not spread across the semiconductor group, while AMD said its 5th Gen EPYC processors power the host infrastructure for Google Cloud's newest TPU system.


On the company side,[Simply Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/why-intel-intc-pushing-deeper-140923172.html) highlighted on November 9 Intel's collaboration with ZKH's LingLong Intelligence on LingLong Insight 1.0, an industrial AI model that pairs Intel edge computing processors with ZKH product data for checks in factories and warehouses. No fetched source tied that collaboration to Monday's move.


## INTC Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Intel Foundry revenue rose 58% year over year to $6.7 billion in the third quarter of 2026, according to[Intel's results release](https://www.intc.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1786/intel-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results) .
- Per[Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/intc-stock-down-57-past-141100035.html) , Intel 18A has entered high-volume production with Panther Lake and Wildcat Lake ramping on it, and the Foundry operating loss narrowed to $1.85 billion from $2.32 billion a year earlier.
- CEO Lip-Bu Tan said in the release that "demand for our CPUs remains robust" and named unlocking more supply for the Xeon family as the immediate priority.


### Risks


- Intel guided fourth-quarter revenue of $15.0 billion to $16.0 billion, below the third quarter's $16.5 billion, with a non-GAAP gross margin of 38.0% and non-GAAP[earnings per share](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-eps-earnings-per-share-meaning-formula-and-how-to-judge-it/) of $0.25.
- CFO David Zinsner said in the release, "we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year."
- Zacks noted that China made up more than 24% of Intel's 2025 revenue, that Beijing has directed foreign chips to be phased out of key telecom networks by 2027, and that the Q4 outlook includes an estimated $300 million hit from a manufacturing disruption in Israel.
